description: This file defines the HomePage component for a chat/messaging application using React. It includes UI components for displaying stories and chat list items, fetches data asynchronously, and manages state related to stories, users, and chats.

classes.name: ChatListItem
classes.description: React functional component representing a single chat list item, showing the other user's avatar, name, last message, timestamp, and unread badge. Handles click to navigate to the chat.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable time string.
